name: Folderly
author: wpfolderly

sections.description:
Folderly is a powerful and intuitive WordPress plugin designed to help you manage your documents, attachments, and posts within virtual folders. Whether you run a content-heavy blog, an online store, or a document repository, Folderly simplifies your file management process, making it easy to organize, locate, and manage your content efficiently.

Key Features:

Virtual Folders
Organize your documents, media files, and posts into customizable virtual folders without changing their original URLs or locations.
Drag-and-Drop Interface
Effortlessly drag and drop files into folders, making file organization quick and intuitive.
Search and Filter
Advanced search and filtering options help you find the documents you need in seconds.
User Permissions
Control who can access and manage folders with robust user permission settings.
Seamless Integration
Integrates smoothly with your WordPress media library and post editor, keeping your workflow uninterrupted.
Lightweight and Fast
Designed with performance in mind, Folderly ensures your site remains fast and responsive even with extensive file collections.

Why Choose Folderly?

  • Folderly is perfect for bloggers, content creators, educators, and businesses looking to keep their WordPress sites organized. With Folderly, you can create a clutter-free environment, making document management more efficient and less time-consuming.
  • Streamline file and content management.
  • Boost your productivity while working on multiple platforms.
  • Enjoy a hassle free experience across diverse WordPress environments.

COMPATIBILITY

Folderly seamlessly integrates with the most popular page builders and themes worldwide, ensuring smooth compatibility and a superior user experience. Whether you’re building stunning websites or managing complex content structures, Folderly adapts to your needs with support for:

✅ Elementor
✅ Beaver Builder
✅ Brizy Builder
✅ Divi Builder
✅ Thrive Architect
✅ Fusion Builder (Avada)
✅ Oxygen Builder
✅ Tatsu Builder
✅ Bricks Builder
✅ BeTheme
✅ Breakdance Builder
✅ Zion Builder
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress backend
  2. Navigate to “Plugins” > “Add New”
  3. Search for “Folderly”
  4. Install and activate the plugin
  5. Go to “Media” in the left sidebar and enjoy the advanced media management with folders
sections.faq:
What is Folderly and how does it work?

Folderly is a WordPress plugin designed to help you organize your media files, posts, and other content into virtual folders. It provides a drag-and-drop interface for easy file management without changing your original file paths or URLs.

Will Folderly affect my existing media files or URLs?

No, Folderly does not alter your existing file paths or URLs. It creates virtual folders that help you organize your files while keeping their original locations intact.

Can I import my existing media folders from other plugins?

Yes, Folderly allows you to seamlessly import your existing media folders from other WordPress plugins, making the transition to Folderly smooth and hassle-free.

Is Folderly compatible with other plugins and themes?

Yes, Folderly is designed to work seamlessly with most WordPress plugins and themes. However, if you encounter any compatibility issues, please reach out to our support team for assistance.

Is there a limit to how many folders I can create?

In the Pro version of Folderly, you can create and manage unlimited folders, including nested structures, to organize your content as extensively as you need.
